name: assembly-newsh2-87
summary: A blue-armed gun walker standing on the ground (two pieces, 48x27 px, mirror symmetric about the edge between cols 22 and 23): a grey armoured hull at the top with a glowing exhaust vent across its back, light grey side pods and a blue glass canopy; red thruster blocks beside it; bright blue T-shaped arm plates out of its sides that drop into blades; blue-steel legs down the outer edges, each an inner and an outer rail arching down to a foot; under the hull a grey block with red vent strips and a pipe down to a round housing with a glowing red eye. Hard-surface machinery: flat bevelled plates and blocks stacked in height, round only for the pods, the pipe, the housing and the eye.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: blue glass panel (cols 19-26, rows 2-7) on top of the hull, glossy, with crisp chamfered edges
raised above the hull deck and framed; light blue rim along its lower edge (row 7)
the bright pixels (131, 133, 136) are glints, not bumps
features.note: Concept: a framed blue screen/windshield in the middle of the hull.

traits: grey armoured block cols 15-30, rows 0-9, the tallest part of the machine (several px above the arms' roots)
flat deck with crisp bevelled edges, not a soft blob
darker lower end (rows 8-9) stepping down towards the stem block
features.note: Baseline script: 'a grey hull at the top'.

traits: two light grey cylinders along the hull's sides (cols 15-18 and 27-30, rows 0-8)
round in section, lit on the left, standing above the hull deck about as high as they are wide
the right pod looks darker in the sprite only because it is in shadow; same shape and colour
features.note: Concept: grey armoured side housings flanking the canopy.

traits: glowing orange-yellow strip across the hull's back end (row 0, cols 19-26), emissive, hottest in the middle
a dark slot under it (row 1)
features.note: Concept: glowing exhaust ports with grilles at the top.

traits: bright blue T-shaped armour plates: a bar out of each hull side (rows 5-6), a thick outer part (rows 7-9) and a blade dropping down (rows 10-16)
flat plates with bevelled lit edges, raised clearly above the legs and red blocks
the blade tapers and lowers towards its dark tip
features.note: Concept: chunky blue T-shaped arm plates with bevels.

traits: blue-steel legs down the outer edges (cols 4-9 and 35-39, rows 3-25)
each an inner rail (cols 8-9 / 36-37) and an outer rail with a dark outer face (col 5 / col 39), joined at a foot (rows 20-25)
rails arch: high at the shoulder by the arms, descending to the foot on the ground, not flat strips on the floor
features.note: Concept: segmented armoured claws curving down either side. The sprite's right outer rail is one px narrower than the left.

traits: red-orange blocks beside the hull (cols 11-13 and 32-34, rows 2-6), hot orange on top
solid raised blocks with chamfered edges, a few px tall
features.note: Concept: red thruster housings with vents behind the arms.

traits: round grey housing (cols 19-26, rows 18-25), about as tall as half its width or more
glowing red eye lens set in its upper part (cols 21-24, rows 19-22) with a hot orange core
features.note: Concept: a spherical pod with a large red lens.

traits: grey block under the hull (cols 20-25, rows 10-13) with dark red vent strips at its sides (cols 20 and 25)
a round grey pipe of constant diameter (cols 22-23, rows 14-17) down to the eye housing
features.note: Concept: a bundle of cables and red-lit vent blocks between the hull and the eye.

traits: small red indicator lights (col 11 / col 34, row 11) in dark sockets
grey knobs (col 16, row 11, and its mirror) in dark sockets under the arms
